captions.detailed: This 3D model features a lightweight mountain bike suspension fork and handlebar assembly. The structure consists of a central silver steerer tube, a black crown, black upper stanchions, silver lower stanchions, and a black handlebar clamped by a black stem. The lower stanchions slide telescopically into the upper stanchions via prismatic joints, while the stem and handlebar rotate relative to the steerer tube via revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a mountain bike suspension fork and handlebar assembly. Ensure it features telescoping lower stanchions with prismatic joints sliding into the upper fork legs, a stem clamped to the central steerer tube with a revolute joint, and a wide handlebar that rotates within the stem clamp.
captions.factory: Construct the assembly by first defining the crown and upper stanchions using Box and Cylinder primitives. Create the telescoping lower stanchions using cylinders and establish a prismatic joint between the upper and lower stanchion components. Model the central steerer tube as a cylinder, and attach the stem clamp using a revolute joint. Finally, construct the handlebar from cylindrical sweeps and grips, mounting it to the stem with another revolute joint.
